mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.media_id, m.media_company_short AS media_short, a.name, a.os_type, a.access_type, a.pkg, a.download_url, a.enable, a.creator, a.create_time, a.updater, a.update_time, a.deleted, a.tenant_id FROM ssp_app a LEFT JOIN ssp_media m ON a.media_id = m.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
